title: Keymaster Resident Qualification
objective: Qualify the repo-proven Keymaster credential lifecycle/health/vault boundary against current V2 secret exclusion, Trust Canal, Switchyard, Rhea and Kronos contracts before any House admission or secret access.
laws: Keymaster governs credential metadata and lifecycle semantics; secret values must never enter House knowledge, logs, UI, Atlas, Mnemosyne or ordinary artifacts.
Trust Canal remains authority for consequential credential actions; Keymaster cannot self-approve store/replace/revoke or deployment use.
Switchyard consumes sanitized provider/credential health facts but does not resolve credentials.
Rhea may consume sanitized Keymaster health; Rhea never reads secrets or rotates credentials.
Kronos may depend on credential readiness evidence but does not absorb Keymaster or key custody.
No provider network validation, secret resolution, rotation, account creation, billing activation or vault mutation in qualification.
Old Hub UI, scheduler, bell and orchestration are not transplanted.
